_readme: The Unconfirmed queue for /df/data-mining/current-bugged-plans/ (17 Nov 2026). Every plan here shows under 'Unconfirmed' until the Duchess makes a call in plan_status.json dated on or after `added`. A daily scheduled review (1pm Perth, 20 plans) fills `review` = {checked, suggest: unreleased|no_source|legacy|now_entm|live, evidence, sources} and reports to her; it never makes the call itself. Groups: pre2020 (no source in any Steam build since Apr 2020), unreleased (current Unreleased calls, re-checked), loose_end, retired_event (added when she marks an event gone in Legacy ESM Archive\results\retired-event-check.csv). Order = review order.
